svg.title: Weekly commits to each protocol, added across its repositories
svg.desc: Small multiples, one panel per protocol, shared scale. MCP 4070 commits in 6 repos; A2A 2050 commits in 8 repos; MPP 1106 commits in 2 repos; x402 1064 commits in 3 repos; UCP 703 commits in 6 repos; KYA-OS 324 commits in 1 repos; L402 272 commits in 3 repos; PAP 179 commits in 4 repos; ANS 104 commits in 2 repos; ACP 100 commits in 1 repos; Web Bot Auth 93 commits in 1 repos; KYAPay 62 commits in 2 repos; x401 47 commits in 2 repos; AP2 20 commits in 1 repos; TAP 1 commits in 1 repos; Baselayer KYA has no data (closed product)
svg.text: Weekly commits to each protocol, added across its repositories
Last 52 weeks to mid-Oct 2026. Same scale in every panel (0 to 190), sorted by total commits.
A flat line on the baseline means no commits. Dashed shading means no repository existed yet. Repositories counted are listed below.
